% Known-good sheet against ak_unit.json (enumerate shape): every problem that
% declares an answer_unit ends with a matching \answerline. cm$^2$ satisfies
% the declared "cm^2" (the tokenizer drops the math wrappers) and "degrees"
% is written out — both directions of the sheet-side gate stay quiet.
\documentclass{article}\usepackage{enumitem}\begin{document}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, itemsep=4cm]
  \item A ramp rises at $35^\circ$ from a point $9$ ft out. Find the height. \answerline{ft}
  \item Find the distance between $(1, 2)$ and $(4, 6)$. \answerline{m}
  \item Find the area of the plot. \answerline{cm$^2$}
  \item Find the area of the triangle. \answerline{square units}
  \item Find the measure of angle $A$. \answerline{degrees}
\end{enumerate}\end{document}
